overview.description: The VanEck Indonesia Index ETF (IDX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MVIS Indonesia index, a market-cap-weighted index of the largest and most liquid Indonesian stocks. IDX was launched on Jan 20, 2009 and is issued by VanEck.
